contradictions.topic: campus capacity and square footage scope
contradictions.details: EdgeCore's current Phoenix/Mesa location page states 496 MW, 2.7M sq ft, 84 acres, and 5 data centers. EdgeCore's 2024/2025 press releases and some local/industry coverage describe 450+ MW or 3.1M+ sq ft/full-buildout context. City ZON25-00535 documents confirm the 2026 north-campus modification at 1,236,960 sq ft but do not assign a north-campus-only MW value.
contradictions.resolution: Use 496 MW only as current company-reported total campus critical IT load; do not treat it as the north-campus expansion's independently verified capacity.

contradictions.details: Company and media sources discuss an operational first building and south-campus buildings under construction/commissioning; official Mesa permit rows support south-campus permits and TCO/C of C activity at 3856 S Everton Terr. No official north-campus building permit, CO, or energization record for 9903 E Elliot Rd was verified.
contradictions.resolution: Keep ZON25-00535 north-campus expansion at local process/site-plan approval, with related-campus construction evidence separated.

verification.reason: Official land-use/site-plan facts are verified, but north-campus-only MW capacity, building permits, CO, and energization remain unverified.
unverified_items: Building permit issuance for the ZON25-00535 north-campus buildings at 9903 E Elliot Rd.
North-campus certificate of occupancy or energization.
